news.body_zh: 周六，一场古老的长距离竞争在斯坦福桥重新燃起。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿预览了斯坦福桥北部坚毅队与国王路狂妄队的第 99 场比赛。就在约克郡人最近造访杯赛十周后，切尔西主场迎战利兹联。在那场卡拉宝杯比赛中，蓝军以 6-3 惊心动魄地战胜了白军，而客队已经有超过四分之一个世纪没有在蓝桥的任何一条战线上获胜了。然而，在国际比赛日之前，利兹联队以1-0击败托特纳姆热刺队，这是自去年9月以来首次取得三分。他们在积分榜上排名第九，而伦敦人在以同样的比分输给桑德兰后滑落至第五。哈维·阿隆索的球队本赛季在主场获得的积分也排名第五，而丹尼尔·法克的球队在客场得分排名第 11。上赛季，这场比赛以2-2结束，蓝军在比赛进行到一小时后仍以2-0领先。我们还在足总杯中以 1-0 获胜，对约克郡人队保持十场不败。切尔西已经比上赛季相应的十场比赛多了八分，并且可以通过一场胜利重返第四位。阿隆索周五下午在赛前新闻发布会上传来的好消息是，乔什·阿奇姆蓬、莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯都可以在国际比赛日后对阵利兹联的比赛中出场。 “莫伊塞斯已经准备好出发了，”我们的经理确认道。 “在（为厄瓜多尔）打完第一场比赛后讨论过他可以节省一些时间。这对他有好处，他很好。” “Emi 在球队中，他可以被选中。两周前对阵桑德兰的比赛可能存在风险，计划是让他与阿根廷队进行更多训练并踢一场比赛。进展顺利，所以他可以上场了。”然而，杰米·吉滕斯、乔雷尔·哈托、里斯·詹姆斯、若奥·佩德罗和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦都仍然没有参加比赛，因为他们继续在科巴姆进行康复工作。 “若昂还不能适应球队训练。我们需要再等一下。他不会参加利兹联的比赛。我们需要每天看看他的感受如何。 “乔雷尔有背部问题。我们需要保持耐心，因为这需要一段时间。”尽管比赛是在中立场地进行的，但这场比赛总是会提到 1970 年切尔西和利兹联之间史诗般的决赛，当时双方都没有赢得足总杯冠军。对于那些目睹了温布利 2-2 的比赛以及在老特拉福德球场凭借大卫·韦伯的头球帮助蓝军取得惊人胜利的人来说，其中的阴谋、文化冲突、暴力和令人满意的结局令人难忘。他们为世世代代两个阵营之间的关系奠定了基调。白军最近于 2025 年重返顶级联赛，而蓝军则在 2020 年至 2023 年的前三个赛季租约期间赢得了所有客场胜利。在 2020 年 12 月的新冠疫情限制性会议中，蓝桥有 2,000 人参加，科巴姆毕业生帕特里克·班福德打破了僵局，但马尔科·贝尔萨的球队看到奥利弗·吉鲁恢复了平局，然后库尔特·祖马和克里斯蒂安·普利西奇取得3-1的胜利。第二年历史重演，利兹联通过点球领先，随后梅森·芒特扳平比分。中场休息后，若日尼奥同样在 12 码处帮助欧洲冠军队取得领先。约克郡人队在比赛还剩 7 分钟时扳平比分，但在比赛结束时若日尼奥罕见的第二个点球将比分定为 3-2。韦斯利·福法纳 (Wesley Fofana) 在 2023 年 3 月为切尔西攻入的首个联赛进球足以让他们获得积分，而几个月后，哈维·格拉西亚 (Javi Gracia) 的球队降级。去年二月，利兹联凭借若奥·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默的进球，以2-2战平，这是他们唯一一次射门得分。切尔西在主场的英超联赛进球数为 13 个，仅次于布莱顿（15 个）。蓝军创下了本赛季顶级联赛最高的射门准确率——41.9%。在国际比赛日期间，蓝军在空战中丢了一个球，在角球处丢了两个球，在点球中丢了两个球。诺丁汉森林队（9 球）和桑德兰队（8 球）是迄今为止进球数少于利兹联队（10 球）的顶级联赛俱乐部。白军在五场客场联赛中的三场首开纪录。迈克·潘德斯 (Mike Penders) 因上个月对阵曼联的指尖扑救而获奖，他是切尔西自 2024 年 10 月罗伯特·桑切斯 (Robert Sanchez) 以来第一位获得英超月度最佳扑救奖的人，也是我们第四次获得此奖。 现在还有时间确保您在斯坦福桥对阵切尔西对阵利兹联的比赛中获得席位。探索切尔西俱乐部的 VIP 招待套餐，享受高级座位、优质餐饮以及周六英超比赛的独家比赛日入场权。数量有限，请立即在此预订切尔西招待会门票。

news.title: Latest update on James and Lacroix returns from Alonso
news.title_zh: 关于詹姆斯和拉克鲁瓦从阿隆索回归的最新消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso discussed the chances of Reece James and Maxence Lacroix getting back on the pitch before the end of the year, as the pair continue their recovery from injury. Both players have been absent in recent weeks - our captain James after undergoing minor knee surgery, centre-back Lacroix due to a hamstring issue. The duo are working hard to get back in the action with Chelsea as soon as possible, but Alonso had already confirmed that our next fixture against Leeds United on Saturday will be too soon for either of them to be involved. The Spaniard has now provided further clarity around hopes that James and Lacroix could be back out on the pitch for the Blues before the end of 2026. ‘I think that Max has a better chance than Reece,’ our manager revealed. ‘It’s not definitely that Reece won’t be back before then, but Max has a better chance.’ James and Lacroix have been important figures in Alonso’s team, starting all but one of the Premier League matches they have been available for. Just like Joao Pedro and Moises Caicedo, who have missed games in recent weeks, their absence would be a blow for any team. However, the Chelsea manager knows that injuries are an unavoidable part of football, and insists it is up to him and the other players to be ready to find solutions on the pitch. ‘We want to have a complete squad, for sure. That's the goal of any manager,’ added Alonso. ‘We have built a good squad, knowing that some players, they have this experience, they have this role, they have this specificity that is very needed, and we are a better team with them. ‘But it's not about making a big drama when someone gets injured, because that happens. So we need to deal with that. ‘We need to find the other players that are available. They need to show that they are good enough, and that's our dynamic.’ Those selected in Alonso’s next starting line-up will be looking to do just that when we host Leeds United at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League for a 3pm kick-off on Saturday. news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索讨论了里斯·詹姆斯和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦在年底前重返球场的机会，因为两人仍在从伤病中恢复。两名球员最近几周都缺席了——我们的队长詹姆斯在接受小膝盖手术后，中后卫拉克鲁瓦则因腿筋问题缺席。两人正在努力尽快重返切尔西的比赛，但阿隆索已经确认，我们周六对阵利兹联的下一场比赛对于他们中的任何一个来说都还为时过早。西班牙人现在进一步明确了希望詹姆斯和拉克鲁瓦能够在 2026 年底前重返蓝军球场的希望。“我认为马克斯比里斯有更好的机会，”我们的经理透露道。 “里斯在那之前不一定会回来，但马克斯有更好的机会。”詹姆斯和拉克鲁瓦一直是阿隆索球队的重要人物，除了一场英超比赛外，他们都首发出场。就像若昂·佩德罗和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多最近几周缺席比赛一样，他们的缺席对任何球队来说都是一个打击。然而，切尔西主教练知道伤病是足球中不可避免的一部分，并坚持认为他和其他球员要做好准备在球场上寻找解决方案。 “我们当然希望拥有一支完整的阵容。这是任何教练的目标。”阿隆索补充道。 “我们已经建立了一支优秀的球队，我们知道有些球员有这样的经验，他们有这样的角色，他们有非常需要的特殊性，与他们一起我们是一支更好的球队。 “但这并不是要在有人受伤时制造一场大闹剧，因为这种事确实会发生。所以我们需要处理这个问题。 “我们需要找到其他可用的球员。他们需要证明自己足够优秀，这就是我们的动力。”当我们周六下午 3 点在英超联赛斯坦福桥迎战利兹联队时，阿隆索下一批首发阵容中的球员将希望做到这一点。现在还有时间确保您在斯坦福桥对阵切尔西对阵利兹联的比赛中获得席位。探索切尔西俱乐部的 VIP 招待套餐，享受高级座位、优质餐饮以及周六英超比赛的独家比赛日入场权。数量有限，请立即在此预订切尔西招待会门票。

news.title: Alonso says Blues are ‘building an identity’ but need consistency
news.title_zh: 阿隆索表示蓝军正在“建立一个身份”，但需要一致性
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes his Chelsea side are well on their way to forming the ‘identity’ he wants to see from them, even though he knows it is a process that takes time. Alonso arrived this summer, since when the Blues have had some standout results, such as the thrilling home wins over Brighton and Bournemouth. The manager recognises the next step is consistency. Developing the character of the team in order to be competitive on a regular basis is his aim. ‘We are building it,’ Alonso said on his team’s identity. ‘I think that this is a process. ‘The goal for us is that we feel that this is our idea of how we want to play, knowing the context, knowing the Premier League, but that we are prepared with whoever we are facing, and that we are competitive. ‘We want to be competitive, and that's the goal. We are lacking a bit of consistency on the results for sure. We have won some games, but had some defeats as well, and we are in that process to get better. It will take a while.’ Leeds provide stiff opposition in our first game back after the international break. Alonso is acutely aware of how tough they are to play against both physically and tactically. They have conceded just eight goals in ten games, and have only been beaten twice. ‘We know that nowadays you need to be flexible each game, even during the game, that one structure can change with the ball, without the ball,’ Alonso said. ‘Leeds are a demanding team, not just physically, tactically as well. They are doing great things with the manager they have. They have been together, so they have a pretty clear idea, and it's going to be a very demanding game.' Alonso added exactly what he wants from his players as they look to get back to winning ways at Stamford Bridge. ‘We need to work,' he said. 'We need to be patient. We need to be intense. We need to have a good concentration and focus, and to know that each detail can be very important.’ There's still time to secure your place for Chelsea v Leeds at Stamford Bridge.
